name: EasyEcom
description_en:
EasyEcom combines multichannel order management, inventory and warehouse operations with accounting connections and optional reconciliation tools. The current official pricing page separates Starter, Growth and Enterprise by operational scale and feature depth.

Its role is broader than a stock ledger: an omnichannel business can coordinate incoming orders, warehouse processing and financial handoff. The exact module package matters, particularly for expiry tracking, ERP access and marketplace payout reconciliation.
description_zh:
EasyEcom 将多渠道订单、库存、仓库作业与会计连接及可选对账工具结合。当前官方价格页按运营规模和功能深度区分 Starter、Growth 和 Enterprise。

其定位超出库存台账，可协调全渠道订单、仓库处理和财务交接。模块组合尤为重要，尤其涉及有效期跟踪、ERP 接入和市场回款对账。

core_features.explanation_en: The platform describes orders, inventory, returns and warehouse operations across online, retail and B2B contexts.
core_features.explanation_zh: 平台描述线上、零售及 B2B 的订单、库存、退货和仓库作业。

core_features.name_zh: 单独收费的对账与视频
core_features.explanation_en: EasyReco handles payment/return reconciliation; EasyVMS links packing/return footage to orders. Both are priced separately.
core_features.explanation_zh: EasyReco 处理付款和退货对账，EasyVMS 将打包和退货视频关联订单，两者单独计费。

sections.title_en: Trace a marketplace order through return and credit note
sections.title_zh: 跟踪市场订单、退货与贷项通知
sections.en: Start with one channel and one warehouse. Map products, import an order, receive or allocate stock, fulfill it and process a return with its credit note. Compare the result with the accounting destination. If payout discrepancies are the problem, include EasyReco explicitly in the demonstration rather than assuming reconciliation is included in basic inventory sync.
sections.zh: 从一个渠道和一个仓库开始，映射商品、导入订单、收货或分配库存、履约，再处理退货及贷项通知，并与会计系统比较。如果核心问题是回款差异，应在演示中明确加入 EasyReco，不能假设基础库存同步已包含对账。

sections.title_en: Match traceability requirements to the plan
sections.en: Starter lists up to three users, roughly 100,000 SKUs and one warehouse. Growth adds purchasing/vendor management, SKU barcoding, FIFO and wholesale flow. Enterprise adds custom roles, ERP/EDI depth, item-level barcoding, FEFO/expiry tracking and full API access. Unlimited channels do not remove warehouse, user or module pricing dimensions.
sections.zh: Starter 列出最多三用户、约 100,000 SKU 和一个仓库。Growth 增加采购与供应商管理、SKU 条码、FIFO 及批发流程。Enterprise 增加自定义角色、ERP/EDI、单件条码、FEFO/有效期跟踪和完整 API。渠道不限并不取消仓库、用户或模块计费维度。

sections.en: No numeric base subscription is published on the pricing page read. Quotes consider orders, SKUs, warehouses, users, integrations and enabled modules; monthly billing and cancellation are advertised. There is no self-serve free trial: the vendor offers a tailored demo. A dedicated engineer is an Enterprise add-on, separate from its dedicated success team.
sections.zh: 已读价格页没有公开基础订阅金额。报价考虑订单、SKU、仓库、用户、集成和启用模块，并宣传月付与可取消。没有自助免费试用，厂商提供定制演示；专属工程师属于 Enterprise 附加项，与专属客户成功团队不同。

sections.title_en: Treat service targets as contractual questions
sections.title_zh: 将服务目标作为合同核查事项
sections.en: The page describes Enterprise inventory-sync and bin-accuracy targets whose exact terms are scoped at onboarding. These are vendor commitments, not our measurements. It distinguishes a first channel in about 72 hours from a standard rollout around ten weeks and complex enterprise work around 12–16 weeks. Verify dependencies, exclusions and recovery obligations before scheduling a cutover.
sections.zh: 页面描述 Enterprise 的库存同步和仓位准确率目标，具体条款在上线阶段确定；这是厂商承诺，非本次实测。它区分约 72 小时接通首个渠道、约十周标准上线，以及约 12–16 周复杂企业项目。切换前应确认依赖、排除项与恢复责任。
